speaker: (a prentice)
text: On Monday, at Richmond. The Queen showed my lord of Essex a book. Printed over sea. His own name at the front of it, for patron.

speaker: (a lawyer)
text: He came out wan and pale. He has kept his chamber since. That is three tellings before eleven, and not one of them has seen the book.

speaker: (a third man)
text: It reckons up how kings have been put by. With examples. The middle aisle says so, and the middle aisle has not a leaf of it.

speaker: john_harrison
text: When the aisle is louder than the stalls, a man keeps his eyes on his own board. You have had Daniel's third book open, and you have not turned the leaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The light is poor. And the aisle is hard to read through.

speaker: richard_field
text: You will hear nothing else from here to Ludgate. Two men were at it in Blackfriars before the bar was pulled, and neither had seen a cover.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Nobody in Paul's has seen it. Everybody can tell you what is in it. That is the shape of a book that has touched a great house.

speaker: (a prentice)
text: They say he swore he never knew the fellow that wrote it, nor gave leave for his name.

speaker: (a lawyer)
text: Swore or not, a name on a front leaf is not a private letter. A dedication sticks.

speaker: (a third man)
text: Examples, they say. Old kings put by. I have not seen an example. I have seen a crowd.

speaker: richard_field
text: Which is why a printer sets his name on a title he will own. I will not own a book I have not seen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor will I talk one I have not seen. Daniel is the book in my hand. I am not buying another.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Is the Daniel already yours, or is he still my board's?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is already mine. I bought him in April. I am only not turning the leaf.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then turn nothing, and carry nothing home that the aisle can repeat. You have a playhouse beyond the bars. Let the playhouse stay there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It stays where it is licensed. I am not cast this afternoon. I came for a book morning, and the morning is noise.

speaker: (a lawyer)
text: My lord keeps his chamber. That much is the same in every mouth. The rest grows as it walks.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Let it walk past the stall. I sell what I can show.

speaker: richard_field
text: And I print what I will sign. Come away from the aisle before it lends you a sentence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. The leaf stays unturned.

speaker: (a third man)
text: Examples. I should like to see one, and I shall not see it here.

speaker: john_harrison
text: You will not see it at this board. Good day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good day, Master Harrison.

speaker: richard_field
text: And do not buy a rumour. They are dearer than the books.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not buying. I am going home with the book I already had.
